name: load-native-library
arguments: Optional PATH names the bridge; default searches build/ and then the system loader.
returns: T after successful load and ABI verification.
description: Load the native bridge once. An explicit path supports packaged applications without consulting ASDF.
scope: May be used before a GUI session. Loader and ABI failures signal Lisp errors.

name: call-with-application
arguments: FUNCTION is a zero-argument function.
description: Initialize a main-thread GUI session, call FUNCTION, and clean up on normal return or unwinding. RUN is explicit.
scope: The Lisp must run on its initial/main thread; nested or repeated application sessions are rejected. Setup/native failures signal NATIVE-ERROR; body conditions propagate.

name: with-application
arguments: Empty options list, followed by BODY forms.
returns: The values of the last BODY form.
description: Evaluate BODY within CALL-WITH-APPLICATION with guaranteed cleanup.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: with-repl-application
arguments: Options INPUT, OUTPUT and ON-ERROR (:DEBUG or :REPORT), then BODY setup forms.
returns: NIL when the cooperative REPL exits.
description: Run setup, then evaluate terminal input while polling GUI events. STOP or EOF exits; incomplete input and debugging pause GUI events.
scope: Main-thread, one-session contract. Setup conditions propagate. :DEBUG preserves restarts; :REPORT prints recovery diagnostics.
wxwidgets: wxApp event polling; SBCL/CCL terminal integration.

name: return-to-application-repl
arguments: No arguments; invoke this restart from the application REPL debugger.
returns: Control returns to the application REPL.
description: Abandon the failing REPL evaluation or callback operation using the active debugger restart.
scope: This is an exported restart name, not a callable function. Available only while the application REPL debugger establishes it.

name: run
arguments: No arguments.
returns: NIL after the event loop returns.
description: Block until STOP or the last top-level frame closes. Callback errors are re-signaled after returning from native code.
scope: Requires at least one frame and no already-running loop. Unavailable inside the application REPL. Native failures and callback conditions propagate.

name: stop
arguments: No arguments.
returns: NIL in the application REPL; T after stopping a native RUN loop.
description: Leave RUN or end the application REPL. Stopping the loop does not destroy windows.
scope: Outside the application REPL, a running native event loop is required; otherwise NATIVE-ERROR.

name: process-events
arguments: No arguments.
description: Process pending GUI events without blocking; re-signal callback errors after polling.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process. Forbidden inside RUN or the application REPL debugger.

name: make-frame
arguments: TITLE string; positive WIDTH and HEIGHT (defaults 480 and 240).
returns: A new Lisp object wrapping the native window handle.
description: Create a top-level frame; native ID and style options use defaults.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: make-panel
arguments: PARENT is a live window.
returns: A new Lisp object wrapping the native window handle.
description: Create a child panel.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: make-button
arguments: PARENT; optional LABEL string (default Button).
returns: A new Lisp object wrapping the native window handle.
description: Create a text button with replaceable click handler support.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: make-text
arguments: PARENT; optional initial VALUE string.
returns: A new Lisp object wrapping the native window handle.
description: Create a single-line editable text control.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: make-label
arguments: PARENT; optional LABEL string.
returns: A new Lisp object wrapping the native window handle.
description: Create static text; wxWidgets label/mnemonic syntax is retained.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: make-checkbox
arguments: PARENT; LABEL string and CHECKED generalized boolean.
returns: A new Lisp object wrapping the native window handle.
description: Create a two-state checkbox with initial boolean state.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: make-choice
arguments: PARENT; ITEMS list of strings; SELECTION zero-based index or NIL.
returns: A new Lisp object wrapping the native window handle.
description: Create a dropdown with copied item strings; NIL means no selection.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: make-column
arguments: PARENT is a live window without a sizer.
description: Attach a parent-owned vertical box sizer. Standalone nested sizer objects are not exposed.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: make-row
arguments: PARENT is a live window without a sizer.

scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: add-child

scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

description: Add flexible layout-axis spacing and relayout the parent.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: layout-window
arguments: WINDOW is a live window.
description: Recompute the window sizer layout, including after batching label changes. Native success boolean is not exposed.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: window-position
arguments: WINDOW is live.
returns: Two integer values: X and Y.
description: Query position relative to parent; frame coordinates are screen-relative.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: window-size

scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

returns: WINDOW, then a boolean indicating whether its shown state changed.

scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: destroy-window
arguments: WINDOW is live.
description: Request destruction; first explicitly unbind handlers to release Lisp closures. Child handles become invalid when native destruction occurs.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: get-text

description: Read the current UTF-8 text; returned storage survives later native calls.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: set-text
arguments: CONTROL is a text control; VALUE is a string; NOTIFY is a generalized boolean.
description: Replace text silently by default. With NOTIFY true, text-change handlers may run synchronously and their conditions are re-signaled to the setter caller.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: get-label
arguments: LABEL is live static text.
description: Read raw label text including mnemonic syntax. Other control types are not accepted.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: set-label

scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: selection

scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: set-selection
arguments: CHOICE; INDEX is NIL or a nonnegative in-range index; NOTIFY generalized boolean.
description: Select or clear the choice. Optional synthetic selection notifications are synchronous, even if unchanged. Handler conditions return to the caller.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: on-click
arguments: BUTTON and FUNCTION; WITH-EVENT true makes FUNCTION accept one EVENT; otherwise no arguments.
description: Replace and release any prior handler. Receive :CLICK snapshots with no payload. Callback conditions never unwind through C++; they are re-signaled at a Lisp boundary.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process. Handler closures stay rooted until explicit unbinding or session cleanup.

name: off-click
arguments: BUTTON is a live source control.
description: Remove the handler and release its closure. Repeated removal is harmless for a live control, including inside its callback.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process. Unbind before destruction; unbinding a destroyed handle is an error.

name: on-text-change
arguments: CONTROL (wxTextCtrl) and FUNCTION; FUNCTION receives one EVENT.
description: Replace and release any prior handler. Receive :TEXT-CHANGE snapshots with copied text. Callback conditions never unwind through C++; they are re-signaled at a Lisp boundary.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process. Handler closures stay rooted until explicit unbinding or session cleanup.

name: off-text-change

scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process. Unbind before destruction; unbinding a destroyed handle is an error.

scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process. Unbind before destruction; unbinding a destroyed handle is an error.

name: queue-click
arguments: BUTTON is a live button.
description: Post a button click for later dispatch. It uses the handler registered at dispatch time, including any replacement.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: native-error
arguments: Condition class; native diagnostic text is available through its printed report.
description: Signals native bridge failures instead of exposing C++ exceptions or native pointers.
scope: Catch with HANDLER-CASE or HANDLER-BIND. Lisp argument and callback conditions retain their own condition types.

name: event
arguments: Snapshot type created by callbacks, without a public constructor.
description: Read-only event snapshot: kind, source, text, checked state and selection. Snapshot strings survive later callbacks and window destruction.
scope: Use only the exported predicate/accessors; native event objects do not escape callbacks.

name: event-p
arguments: OBJECT is any Lisp value.
returns: T for an EVENT, otherwise NIL.
description: Test whether an object is a Lisp-owned event snapshot.
scope: No GUI session required.

name: event-kind
arguments: EVENT is an event snapshot.
description: Read the event kind.
scope: No active GUI session required for saved snapshots. Wrong argument types signal Lisp type errors.

name: event-source
arguments: EVENT is an event snapshot.
returns: The original source Lisp control object.
description: Read the source object; its native handle may subsequently be destroyed.
scope: No active GUI session required for saved snapshots. Wrong argument types signal Lisp type errors.

name: event-text
arguments: EVENT is an event snapshot.
returns: Independent string for text-change events; otherwise NIL.
description: Read the copied text payload.
scope: No active GUI session required for saved snapshots. Wrong argument types signal Lisp type errors.

name: event-checked-p
arguments: EVENT is an event snapshot.
description: Read toggle state; NIL also applies to non-toggle events.
scope: No active GUI session required for saved snapshots. Wrong argument types signal Lisp type errors.

name: event-selection
arguments: EVENT is an event snapshot.
description: Read choice selection; NIL means no selection or a non-selection event.
scope: No active GUI session required for saved snapshots. Wrong argument types signal Lisp type errors.

name: shown-p
arguments: WINDOW is live.
description: Read the window's own shown flag. A hidden ancestor does not change this flag; it does not report effective screen visibility.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: enable-window
arguments: WINDOW is live; optional ENABLE is a generalized boolean (default T).
returns: WINDOW, then a boolean indicating whether its native enabled state changed.
description: Enable or disable user input. Repeated requests are harmless; a disabled parent also disables its children effectively.
scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.

name: enabled-p
arguments: WINDOW is live.

scope: Requires an active GUI session on the process main thread. Invalid/destroyed handles or unsupported native arguments signal NATIVE-ERROR; Lisp argument/type errors remain Lisp conditions. One GUI session per process.
